title.narrative: Sustainable Energy for Public Services entities, entrepreneurship and innovation - EU Support to Lebanon's Green Agenda

description.narrative: The action will support the uptake of renewable energy and energy efficiency equipment in public sector buildings, hence contributing to both energy transition and a more efficient provision of public services. It will also foster entrepreneurship, innovation and technology transfers for sustainable energy solutions in the private sector.
